explication: Qwen Audio Agent is a realtime voice runtime for persistent conversation alongside asynchronous Agent work. A user connects through Web, mobile, terminal, or desktop; the Gateway connects the voice frontend, handles conversation and tools, delegates sustained work to a backend Agent, and returns task progress and results to the conversation. The README documents this workflow and the broader capabilities shown here; sampled source confirms selected transport, task, delivery, and client behaviors, but not every subsystem’s internal wiring.
